environment.dependencyPolicy: Native gates use --offline --locked; wasm check uses --offline. No new dependencies.

evidenceType: Targeted regression/oracle tests and source verification; not performance benchmarking.

after.command: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="wasm_js"' cargo check --offline --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path bindings/wasm/Cargo.toml

checks.limits: This agent checked compilation; the boundary agent owns actual scalar/SIMD binding lifecycle tests.

before.failure: With more than eight f32 ties, bounded candidate oversampling omitted the canonical f64 top result.

checks.acceptance: Exact candidate IDs/order use canonical arithmetic; no fixed oversampling correctness claim.

before.failure: Route changes changed sparse tie winners; NSG truncated variable-density candidates before canonical ranking.

checks.acceptance: Shipped similarity scores are Jaccard, ties use IDs, NSG reranks its whole candidate beam. ANN candidate recall remains approximate.

before.failure: Unrepresentable dimensions/label counts and usize::MAX result capacity panicked on integer overflow.

checks.acceptance: Dimensions 1..=66051, at most 1048576 labels, checked shape products and bounded capacity. Tests include boundary values and usize::MAX.

failures: Filtered hybrid capture retained the broad owner set and missed index reuse.
Mixed position capabilities rejected a recoverable phrase query.
Whole-document lexical ingestion rejected its single embedding.
BM25 k1=0 with absent terms produced an empty answer rather than the independent oracle.

checks.acceptance: 43 passed, one pre-existing microbenchmark ignored. Filtered exact index reuse, candidate-limited lexical owner capture, phrase text fallback and replay compose correctly.

before.status: source verified; no fabricated before-run failure
before.failure: Multi-hop frontiers could grow exponentially; concept neighborhoods retained quadratic hot-dimension candidates. Unknown relation lookup inserted an atom.

checks.acceptance: Checked APIs report work/frontier/byte exhaustion, preserve distinct paths, charge deleted/nonmatching scanned triples, and retain one concept candidate frontier at a time. Legacy Vec-returning APIs use documented bounded/panic contracts.

before.failure: Rebuild included tombstoned coordinates; delete/reuse of an ID could return a live row for deleted coordinates.

checks.acceptance: Rebuilt postings/IDF match a fresh live-only index and no longer return the reused ID on stale coordinates.

before.status: runtime durability regression reproduced; owner-consolidation defect source verified
before.failure: A governed-away atom sharing a raw vector ID reappeared on reopen; direct governance changed memory outside the journal and revision gate.

limitations: These checks demonstrate the named correctness and durability contracts; they do not establish throughput, RSS ceilings, p95/p99 latency, crash-at-every-write coverage or frontier superiority.
QueryLimits work units and conservative retained-byte accounting are not a CPU deadline or a process RSS measurement.
Encoder equal-key selection portability is an unverified cross-toolchain hypothesis (audit confidence 3); permanent old encoder outputs were preserved and no unvalidated new encoder was introduced.
Default-feature format tests skip fixtures requiring security/experimental features; full integrated all-feature/default, release-format and regenerated Node surface checks belong to the coordinator.
